controlledCanvas.method: Real browser RAF; modes overview-zoom, detail-zoom, focus, fit, hover, selected-hover, pan-overview, pan-overview-selected, pan-detail, pan-selected; 24 sinusoidal wheel-input zoom frames across LOD thresholds; actual requested 600ms focus/fit animations measured through their exact final target and two drained RAFs for final submission/render (10s timeout); 24 native PointerEvent hover positions with exact hit testing; 60 RAF pan inputs per pan mode after eight warm-up draws and a separately recorded cold raster setup; trusted wheel and pointer preflights; all 13574 nodes and 23073 edges loaded, all 13 fields/planned/definitions enabled. Oversized DPR2 uses full-resolution direct fallback. Additional settled-raster latency and final draw costs are reported separately. CPU submission time and browser frame cadence use performance.now after callbacks, including the final drained paint, rather than pre-paint RAF timestamps. No universal-device performance claim.

rejectedWebGLPrototype.reason: Material matched animation regression. The prototype bypasses raster reuse, tessellates changing visible groups and composites WebGL tiles into Canvas; per-stage GPU costs were not separately profiled. Its logical tile cap does not preserve the production complete resource budget.
